Friends (2001) : Brief Review -

A blockbuster friendship drama. I couldn't find subtitles for the original Malayalam flick, so I had to watch this Tamil version. As I read online, Siddique made no changes to it, so I don't think the Malayalam version would be much different-except for the fact that it was the original, so it might be better. Friends follows the story of three friends and their bond, and how their friendship is tested through different situations. I have to give credit to the storyline and screenplay because it's smart work by all means. It feels flawless as a drama, as there are so many conflicts, yet there is no mess. The conflicts look real; they are cleverly woven into the narrative-the setup, the lineup of events-everything flows in the right direction. All that without losing the emotional connect. Actually, it's mostly about two characters-two friends who are more than just friends. The third one is just there to fill the space, but even his presence means a lot. You know, you need a third friend to settle things between two friends whenever something goes wrong. The film keeps it high on emotions and drama while following some familiar clichés. From one friend resisting his love because the girl is the sister of his best friend to the same man being blamed for being overly suspicious. The past story, the tragedy, adds a new dimension that brings solid substance to the narrative. Throughout, it's an entertaining film loaded with comedy, romance, action, and drama. The performance by Vijay is good, Suriya feels perfectly suited to his part, and Ramesh Khanna fares well in his role. Vijayalakshmi and Devayani have also done well, along with a highly supportive cast. The film isn't technically right every time, and the cinematic liberty is quite visible too. But that doesn't mean it loses momentum. Siddique was smart enough to create a gripping entertainer without relying much on heavy artistic elements. In short, a superb film.

RATING - 7/10*

By - #samthebestest.

Jyothika was initially supposed to do Devyani's role (as Vijay's wife) and Suvalakshmi was supposed to do Vijayalakshmi's role (as Suriya's love interest). Photoshoots were conducted with Jyothika, Suvalakshmi and the three male leads (Vijay, Suriya and Ramesh Khanna). However for reasons unknown, they were replaced by Devyani and Suvalakshmi.
